limitations: Partial focus/selector occlusion only. The center remains usable and ordinary page scroll recovers full visibility; no total-inaccessibility or WCAG-conformance conclusion.
Tablet screenshots show the clean empty-form reproduction and manual-scroll recovery. The desktop control screenshot contains long synthetic QA LOCAL input and is not an identical-input comparison.
No same overlap was reported in the tested 402 and 1180 controls; this is not a comprehensive accessibility pass.
Only the targeted /teams/new level-focus evidence is included. No inquiry-form, member-list, contact, birth-date, profile-ID, or credential evidence is included.
Exact serving page SHA was not directly observed.
Browser-native window/zoom testing; no physical mobile, software keyboard, touch, or screen-reader testing.
